meta.title: Sparse day
meta.description: One item per shift: a quiet day, below the threshold the navigation buttons appear at.

scenario: Three items, one in each rendered shift. A quiet day is worth designing for: it is what a new installation looks like, and what most days look like in a small team.
look: No navigation buttons. They appear from five items in a shift, and three shifts of one are not close.
The timeline keeps the full height of the shift. An hour is an hour whether or not anything is in it.
The list view drops the empty time between the items, which is the difference between the two views on a quiet day.
One item carries a tag; the rest carry none.
uses: <link to="/navigation/">Navigation</link> — the threshold, and what the buttons do once they appear.
<link to="/timeline-view/">Timeline view</link> — time as distance, empty hours included.
<link to="/list-view/">List view</link> — the same items with the empty time taken out.
